info.name: 🎯 Belderchin IDP - NEW Simplified Auth Flow
info.description:
🚀 **NEW SIMPLIFIED AUTHENTICATION FLOW**

This collection demonstrates the **unified authentication architecture** where Auth-Bridge issues JWT tokens directly, eliminating the need for separate backend login APIs.

## 🔄 **FLOW COMPARISON**

### 🆕 **NEW Simplified Flow (This Collection)**
1. Client → POST /verification/start (phone/email)
2. Client → POST /verification/confirm (code) → JWT Token + User Data
3. Client → Backend APIs (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>)

### 🔄 **OLD Complex Flow (Deprecated)**
1. Client → POST /verification/start → Session Token
2. Client → POST /verification/confirm → Session Token
3. Client → POST /api/auth/login (session + phone) → JWT Token
4. Client → Backend APIs (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>)

## ✅ **BENEFITS OF NEW FLOW**
- ✅ 50% fewer API calls
- ✅ Single source of truth for user data
- ✅ Better performance (no inter-service calls)
- ✅ Simplified client logic
- ✅ Centralized authentication management

## 🎯 **SERVICES IN THIS COLLECTION**
- **Auth-Bridge** (Port 8080): Complete authentication service
- **Backend** (Port 8082): Business logic with JWT validation
- **Test Endpoints**: For development and debugging

---
**📅 Last Updated**: February 25, 2026 - Architecture Migration Complete

item.description:
🎯 **AUTH-BRIDGE: COMPLETE AUTHENTICATION SERVICE**

This folder contains all Auth-Bridge endpoints for the **new unified authentication architecture**.

## 🔄 **KEY CHANGES**

- ✅ **JWT Token Issuance**: Verification endpoints now return JWT tokens directly
- ✅ **No Backend Login Needed**: Eliminates separate login step
- ✅ **User Data Management**: Profile endpoints included
- ✅ **Simplified Flow**: 50% fewer API calls for authentication

## 🎯 **SERVICE RESPONSIBILITY**

Auth-Bridge is now the **complete authentication service**:
- User verification (phone/email)
- JWT token issuance
- User profile management
- 2FA support
- Session management (legacy)

## 🌐 **BASE URL**

`{{auth_bridge_url}}` = `http://localhost:8080`

item.description:
📚 **BACKEND: BUSINESS LOGIC SERVICE**

This folder contains backend endpoints that work with the **new unified authentication architecture**.

## 🔄 **KEY CHANGES**

- ✅ **No Login API**: Removed `POST /api/auth/login` endpoint
- ✅ **JWT Validation**: Local JWT token validation
- ✅ **Redis Integration**: Direct user data access
- ✅ **Business Focus**: Pure business logic, no auth concerns

## 🎯 **SERVICE RESPONSIBILITY**

Backend is now a **pure business logic service**:
- Course management
- User progress tracking
- Content delivery
- JWT validation (local)
- Redis user data access
- ❌ ~~Authentication~~: Handled by Auth-Bridge

## 🌐 **BASE URL**

`{{backend_url}}` = `http://localhost:8082`
